newsitem.title: USA: FOB Gulf Grain - Corn, soy steady, HRW wheat up.
newsitem.headline: FOB Gulf Grain - Corn, soy steady, HRW wheat up.

text.p: U.S. Gulf FOB corn and soybean basis bids were mostly steady on Monday while hard red winter wheat values rose supported by a lack of movement, dealers said.

In export news, Pakistan issued separate tenders on Monday for 270,000 tonnes of US Grade 2 or better soft white wheat and Australian white milling wheat for delivery between Jan 8-31. Also, the U.S. Department of Agriculture's weekly export inspections report cited soy inspections at only 20.495 million bushels for the week ended December 5.
That tally was below trade estimates for 28 to 33 million bushels and was sharply below the 35.321 million the prior week.
